dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible thick white band across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against darker wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent pale-to-white edging along the folded primaries and secondaries, creating sharp, tiered boundaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Large, roughly rectangular white patch on the posterior neck providing high contrast between the crown and mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct, linear demarcation between the black crown and the white nape area.

other_distinctive_markers: Sharp white facial/cheek patch bordered by black crown and throat region.
